name: Koshino Hana
source: A daycare worker at a kindergarten located near the park where the protagonist slacks off during work. She feels extremely apologetic about the fact that it was one of the children under her care that hit the protagonist with a ball, as such, she often talks about properly apologizing to him in a concrete way. She is a kind, even motherly, woman, going so far as to look out for the protagonist's diet.
